description.narrative:
New Narratives overall goal is to strengthen local independent journalism in Liberia to actively contribute as part of a whole-of-society effort to combat corruption and support good governance and human rights.
New Narratives are proposing to make a slight change to their first objective to reflect the new activities focused on War and Economic Crimes Court reporting. The overall goal continues to be to strengthen local independent journalism in Liberia to actively contribute as part of a whole-of-society effort to combat corruption and support good governance and human rights.
With the new outcome, two main outcomes are expected to be achieved by the intervention:
1) Liberian journalists are equipped with resources, know-how and support, including through strong relationships with relevant non-media CSOs, to pursue independent and investigative journalism during and after the project,including on the war and economics crimes courts.
2) Liberian news organizations and New Narratives have the resources and know-how to enhance financial viability in a sustainable way to support investigative journalism.
This will be achieved by the following broad activities, thoroughly outlined in the proposal, which each include a number of different outputs to promote and boost a sustainable investigative journalism ecosystem by:
a) Building strong investigative and independent journalism capacity; b) Building trusted news organizations with large reach and sustainable, independent revenue; c) Strengthening civil society collaborations; d) Offer investigative journalism grants to journalists at the concerned newsrooms

Insatsen syftar till att stärka självständig and kvalitativ journalistik i Liberia, genom att möjliggöra för New Narratives att bistå med stipendier till journalister och kapacitets bygga liberianska mediahus. New Narratives kommer stötta nyhetsredaktioner med kapacitetsstärkning, journalist-stipendier och kompetensförstärkning fokuserat på digital mediaproduktion och företagsutvecklande. Programmet syftar till att utrusta liberianska journalister och nyhetsredaktioner med resurser, know-how och stöd för att kunna bedriva självständig och grävande journalistik.

The contribution appraised here aims to strengthen independent and qualitative journalism in Liberia by supporting New Narratives to provide production grants to journalists and capacity build Liberian media houses. New Narratives will target newsrooms, with capacity building, journalism-grants and skills strengthening focused on digital media production and business support. The programme aims to equip Liberian journalists and news organisations with the resources, know-how and support to pursue independent and investigative reporting.

title.narrative: Grant Agreement between Sida and New Narratives, Inc Regarding Excellence in Independent Journalism in Liberia

description.narrative:
100 investigative reports produced and published or broadcasted by New Narrative journalist-fellows: Using the training, the financial grants provided to the fellows and with the support in editing from the New Narratives team, the fellows have produced pieces for radio, newspapers and other media outlets. Many of these investigations have had ripple effects contributing to bigger impact in different areas, such as the government delivering on promises or further investigations being opened up by responsible parties.
19 episodes produced of the investigative podcast Liberia: Democracy in Focus produced, posted online and aired on radio, providing high quality investigative reports on thematic issues. New Narratives are pioneering the podcast format in Liberia, and the episodes are also aired on prime time on radio stations with large audiences. The podcast was one of few shows that offered in depth investigation on how candidates in the presidential election were addressing key issues such as agriculture and education. Translated episodes of "Democracy in Focus" and special interviews translated to local languages and aired on community radio stations in hard to reach areas
Provided legal support and guidance on how to protect witnesses from psychosocial harm for journalists.
Examples of stories produced: - 4-part series on the state of education - "How the government silenced Accountability in Runup Election" - "Activists say Govts Failure to Release Auditors Death Report Creating Trust Crisis" - 2-part stories on "EUs Failed US3M Bid to fic Monrovias Trash Crisis" - "Weah Government Claims Drop in Poverty but World bank Says Its Highest in a Decade" - "Sinoe Forest Community Fumes Over Numerous Illegalities by Forestry"
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
